name: clearbit
description: DEPRECATED — Clearbit is now HubSpot data enrichment (Breeze Intelligence name retired in 2026); no standalone Clearbit MCP server exists

requirements: No Clearbit setup — the product no longer exists standalone
For enrichment: a paid HubSpot plan (data enrichment is included and consumes no HubSpot Credits)
For intent: 6sense access, or HubSpot buyer intent (metered in HubSpot Credits)
notes: Clearbit was acquired by HubSpot (Dec 2023), rebranded Breeze Intelligence (Sept 2024), and the Breeze Intelligence name was retired in 2026 — the capability is now data enrichment built into HubSpot Smart CRM.
Standalone Clearbit subscriptions stopped (April 2025); free Clearbit tools sunset 2025-04-30; the free Logo API sunset 2025-12-01.
Clearbit has NO MCP server of its own. The 'url' field is null on purpose so nothing points at a non-existent endpoint.
Map doddle.tool.v1.clearbit.company onto HubSpot's enrichment / intent capabilities and use the hubspot entry (https://mcp.hubspot.com) to serve it.
For buyer intent, prefer 6sense (read-only intent, keyword and account insight).

HubSpot buyer intent is metered in HubSpot Credits: 10 credits per company per month to enable / monitor intent signals, 50 credits per month per custom signal. Enrichment itself consumes no HubSpot Credits.

Legacy Clearbit REST endpoints still answer for existing customers (no new signups): person.clearbit.com/v1/combined/find, company.clearbit.com/v2/companies/find, reveal.clearbit.com/v1/companies/find. The free Logo API (logo.clearbit.com) no longer resolves.
HubSpot’s own MCP (mcp.hubspot.com, OAuth 2.0) covers CRM only — it does NOT expose enrichment.
Write path for enrichment today is HubSpot CRM property updates (PATCH /crm/v3/objects/contacts/{id}) with a private-app token. Dry-run: GET-then-diff before PATCH, or write to a scratch property.

source.note: Clearbit has no MCP server of its own — this entry is a deprecated alias onto HubSpot enrichment/intent and 6sense intent.
